mechanism: 신용 여건의 변화가 차입 수요·부채 이용 비용·자금조달 구조 경로를 통해 기업 재무레버리지의 증가로 이어질 수 있다는 조건부 설명 초안이다.
conditions: 논문의 처치·결과 정의와 대상 기업의 변수 정의가 일치할 것
논문의 모집단·시기·제도 및 효과 발생 시차가 적용 대상과 부합할 것

원자료 R07226의 적용 맥락: This paper studies the U.S. housing boom and bust around the Great Recession (roughly 1997–2015), combining household-level lifecycle heterogeneous-agent data and aggregate time series. The unit of analysis is households in an overlapping-generations setting interacting with competitive rental, construction, and mortgage intermediation markets. It calibrates a structural incomplete-markets model with long-term defaultable mortgages, HELOCs, rental markets, and shocks to productivity, housing finance (LTV, PTI, origination costs) and beliefs about future housing demand, and evaluates counterfactuals including large-scale mortgage principal forgiveness.
